row.notes: Adds a named field object to a container: fails with 0x11 when the name already exists (0x143931730), grows the u16-counted pointer array, allocates the type's size/align (type vtbl+0x20/+0x30) + 8 bytes, stores the FNV-1a 64 hash of the name after the object (string pool 0x14392a0c0) and returns it in *param_4. call sites (save writers). Better name: Gdb_Add_ReflectedField (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V10334 Allocates a new child node: checks key not present (error 0x11 on duplicate), grows the pointer array and creates the field; generic child-field creator rather than reflected-class writer.
